verdict.rationale: The docs say Bots can save a multi-step path as a skill and rerun it on a schedule, with an example routine that runs every weekday at 8:00 AM. Routines can also start from events such as Slack or GitHub notifications, and work runs on a persistent cloud computer while your laptop is closed. A month-long user confirms each bot owns its own routines and that async work 'actually works'. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off (single future-time) scheduling, and documentation of how scheduled-run results or notifications are pushed back to the user beyond reviewing results in the mobile app.
